neighbours.label: a noun naming one unit in a sequence (generation, wave, sprint, item, stop, bar), especially after an ordinal or 'next/new'
fire: She looks like a Korean girl of the third generation in Tokyo.
Third Wave coffee shops focus on light roasts and single origins.
The manager clicked to add a new sprint to the board.
Our next stop on the tour is the old harbor.
Practice the first bar until it is smooth, then the second bar.
The fourth round of talks will begin on Monday.
Each order item is processed by a separate worker.
The second phase of construction starts in May.

Practice the song until it is smooth, then play it again.
